Full license: tlsf.h.
Local change: tlsf_realloc uses tlsf_memalign(tlsf, 8, size) for new and
moving allocations, ensuring eight-byte aligned LuaJIT TValue allocations.
Requested payload plus the existing block header is rounded to an eight-byte
stride, so repeated splits do not create leading alignment fragments.
TLSF's original internal block/header alignment is unchanged. Shrinking
and in-place growing preserve the already aligned client pointer.
The existing port heap mutex provides serialization. No extra pools or
fallback allocations are permitted beyond the fixed 96 MiB Lua reservation.
